gold: Juvenile spring eruption (JSE) associated with parvovirus B19 infection

selector.rationale: The presence of intensely pruritic skin eruption, erythema, helical thickening, and numerous small blisters, along with the detection of PVB19 DNA in lesional skin biopsy specimen, supports Erythema multiforme as the most likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Phototoxic reaction
rejected.why: The patient had no history of photosensitivity and standard phototesting with UV-A and UV-B was unremarkable.

rejected.label: Parvovirus B19 infection
rejected.why: While PVB19 DNA was detected, the clinical presentation is more consistent with Erythema multiforme, which can be triggered by Parvovirus B19 infection.
